paper_title: First results from BRASS-p broadband searches for hidden photon dark matter
notes: Paper presents detection sensitivity forecasts from BRASS-p SR1 measurements (Nov-Dec 2022) covering hidden photon masses 49.63-74.44 μeV (12-18 GHz). No actual measured exclusion limit: first inspections found no obvious signal candidate; detailed signal searches deferred to future publication. Detection sensitivity formula given in Eq. 3.4. Sensitivity curves shown in Figures 11-13 represent achievable detection capability, not measured bounds on kinetic mixing parameter χ.
